source: Swift 1.6.0 is the last version to use a Python pickle format. Subsequent versions use a different serialization format.  **Rings generated by Swift versions 1.6.0 and earlier may be read by any version, but rings generated after 1.6.0 may only be read by Swift versions greater than 1.6.0.**  So when upgrading from version 1.6.0 or earlier to a version greater than 1.6.0, either upgrade Swift on your ring building server **last** after all Swift nodes have been successfully upgraded, or refrain from generating rings until all Swift nodes have been successfully upgraded.
candidate_a: Swift 1.6.0 버전은 Python pickle 포맷을 사용하여 생성되지만, 이후 버전들은 새로운 직렬화 형식을 사용합니다. **1.6.0 이전에 생성된 루프는 모든 버전에서 읽을 수 있지만, 1.6.0 이후에 생성된 루프는 Swift 버전이 1.6.0 이상일 때만 읽을 수 있습니다.** 그러므로 1.6.0 또는 이전 버전으로 업그레이드하는 경우 ring-building 서버에서 먼저 Swift를 업그레이드한 후에 모든 Swift 노드가 성공적으로 업그레이드되는 동안 ring을 업그레이드하거나, 새로운 루프 생성과 밀착 후에 나머지 downgrade 작업을 계속하십시오.
candidate_b: Swift 1.6.0은 last.version에서 pickle.format을 사용합니다 . Subsequent versions use different serialization format. Rings generated by Swift versions 1.6.0 and earlier may be read by any version, but rings generated after 1.6.0 may only be read by greater than 1.6.0 version. **Rings generated by Swift versions 1.6.0 or earlier may not be opened by version 1.7.0 or later.** So when upgrading from version 1.6.0 or earlier to a version greater than 1.6.0, either upgrade Swift on your ring building server last after all Swift nodes have been successfully upgraded , or refrain from generating rings until all Swift nodes have been successfully upgraded.
